_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); athletic footwear and apparel signals

pit_profile.why: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and athletic apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2010 10-K); the industry 'is keenly competitive in the United States and on a worldwide basis', 'including Adidas, Puma, and others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and athletic apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2010 10-K); the industry 'is keenly competitive in the United States and on a worldwide basis', 'including Adidas, Puma, and others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.65x; +60% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.74; conservative 2yr -5%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY01-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +12.1%/yr (Q2 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.2%/yr (FY01-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY01-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NKE (retrospective, 2011-02-11) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.65x (36.2% downside to Bear $55 / +13.7% upside to Bull $98) | Adj composite 2.64 vs market 3.38: gap -0.74 [OVERVALUED] | +60% above the EPP floor $54 (14x FY11E $3.86) | Conservative 2-yr case: -4.7% total (-2.4%/yr) | At 22.3x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $114 sits above the BULL case; futures orders +11.0% in Q2 FY11, forward revenues +11% (Q2 FY11 revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
